description: Seasonal cozy variant of the Mitzy mascot shown during the Winter Arc season (Dec 1 - end of February). Delivered by the design team as individual PNG files with transparency, a native 8% mint-tinted circular background, and 2px line-art style, consumed from assets/images/.

resolver_methods.resolve(date): Returns winter arc asset during season if its file exists, else standard banner
resolver_methods.isWinterArcSeason(date): Boolean: whether a date is in the winter arc window
resolver_methods.winterIsAvailable(date): Boolean: seasonal window AND asset file exists
resolver_methods.variantPath(key): Returns the asset path for a named variant (cozy/frosty/scarf)

screens.usage: 56x56 logical px, right of the 'Meet Mitzy' pill on splash screen
100x100 logical px circular avatar above 'Enjoying Mita?' dialog

notes_for_ai_agent: The seasonal resolver (lib/core/mitzy_assets.dart) already swaps to the winter assets during Dec-Feb.
Delivered PNGs live in assets/images/ (pubspec already bundles that whole folder, so no pubspec change needed).
The assets natively include a subtle 8% mint-tinted circular background - do NOT wrap them in an extra circle/bounding box in the UI.
The design team also produced SVG sources and recommended flutter_svg; if SVG files are added later under assets/images/characters/, update pubspec accordingly.
